meta.name: playwright-skill
meta.description: Complete browser automation with Playwright. Auto-detects dev servers, writes clean test scripts to /tmp. Test pages, fill forms, take screenshots, check responsive design, validate UX, test login flows, check links, automate any browser task. Use when user wants to test websites, automate browser interactions, validate web functionality, or perform any browser-based testing.

copy.tagline: 用 Playwright 自动测试网页、填写表单、截图和验证功能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用代码自动操作浏览器来测试网站或完成重复任务
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser testing, form filling, screenshots, and validation with Playwright
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate browser interactions for testing or repetitive tasks

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能自动检测本地开发服务器，编写 Playwright 脚本并执行，完成网页测试、表单填写、截图、检查响应式设计、验证登录流程、检查链接等浏览器自动化任务。
howto.when: 当你要求测试网站、自动化浏览器操作、验证网页功能或进行任何基于浏览器的测试时触发。

say.text: 帮我测试一下本地 3001 端口的登录页面。
say.note: Claude 会检测服务器，编写登录测试脚本并执行。

say.text: 检查我的网站首页有没有坏链。
say.note: Claude 会编写脚本遍历页面链接并报告结果。

say.text: 给当前页面在不同屏幕尺寸下截图。
say.note: Claude 会生成桌面、平板、手机三种视图的截图。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can auto-detect local dev servers, write Playwright scripts, and execute them to perform browser automation tasks such as testing web pages, filling forms, taking screenshots, checking responsive design, validating login flows, and checking links.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to test a website, automate browser interactions, validate web functionality, or perform any browser-based testing.

say_en.text: Test the login page on localhost:3001.
say_en.note: Claude will detect the server, write a login test script, and run it.

say_en.text: Check my homepage for broken links.
say_en.note: Claude will write a script to crawl links and report results.

say_en.text: Take screenshots of the current page at different screen sizes.
say_en.note: Claude will generate screenshots for desktop, tablet, and mobile views.
